response_text: {"decomposition_id":"D1","label":"Enterprise Risk-Governance Framework Approval with IDI Addendum","object":"A single board-level approval of one enterprise risk-governance framework and strategy, satisfiable at the IDI level through an addendum that accommodates reliance on the enterprise framework.","consolidated_text":"The board of directors, as the source of authority and responsibility for sound policies and objectives, shall require management to establish, and shall approve, a single formal written enterprise risk-governance framework, together with the associated risk-management policies of the firm's global operations, and shall periodically review that framework and those policies. In discharging this duty the board (with senior management) shall set a clear risk appetite, strategic focus, and objectives; establish and maintain the culture, incentives, structure, and processes supporting sound risk management; give final approval to the written policies; and provide active oversight of risk-management processes and internal controls. Where the firm operates through one or more insured depository institutions, the requirement for a separate institution-level framework approval is deemed satisfied by an IDI addendum that documents the institution's reliance on, and any institution-specific supplements to, the approved enterprise framework, subject to any exception applicable to that framework-approval obligation.","operands_cited":["b:RGC-02","b:RGC-07","s:FDR-01","s:FDR-02","s:GOV-15","s:GOV-20"],"notes":"Consolidation folds the risk-committee/board approval-and-review duties (RGC-02, RGC-07) and the foundational board-responsibility statements (FDR-01, FDR-02, GOV-15, GOV-20) into one enterprise framework approval. The IDI addendum clause expresses the DEEM_SATISFIED and FACTOR_EXCEPTION operations on RGC-07; scope, actors, and standards drawn only from the operands."}
